bio_am: Մշեցի ֆետայի, 1904-ին միացաւ Անդրանիկի խումբին եւ ինկաւ Փոխիկի խումբին հետ՝ 1904 Հոկտեմբեր 28-29-ին։
bio_en: Nazar Alamsharian was a native of Mush who worked from a young age to support his family and was known as a keen hunter and marksman. When the Sasun events began in 1904 he left home and joined Andranik's band in the mountains, fighting to the end of the uprising and once bringing back the weapons of eight enemies he had killed. In August 1904 he crossed into Persia with Andranik and wintered with local fighters. He then joined Pokhik's armed band on its journey toward Van and Sasun and was killed in its last fight on 28-29 October 1904.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Birth year 1870 from the story title. The original article dated the band's departure to spring 1905; an editor's note in the archive corrects this to 1904.
